verdict_scope: The exact executable RED research prototype is rejected as a correct advancement subject. Its explicit zero-credit and no-production labels remain true; this verdict awards no full-denominator or parser credit.

official_replay.scope_correction: The 29 inherited V8 cases execute occurrence-owner-v8/discover.mjs through runCounterfixtures(); they never call the V9 analyzer. Only the 18 V9 cases, totaling 1121 input bytes, directly exercise analyzeSource().

total_denominator_fit.finding: No pinned source has been analyzed, the 168-source normative operation ledger does not exist, no denominator shards or compatibility join are emitted, and no publication path exists. This is 0/168 full-source coverage, not a total denominator.

analyzer_correctness_state_and_byte_posi.finding: The classifier admits a mid-line fragment as an ATX heading, misses inherited inline-tag ATX headings, accepts an invalid raw-element closer, emits an invalid zero-width href candidate, and advances the ESCAPE state by UTF-16 code units so one astral character is assigned to the wrong state.

ownership_and_dispositions.finding: Heading ownership inherits false and missing headings; operation binding is ordinal or anchor-only rather than pinned occurrence identity; the oracle accepts two ledger rows for one operation interval and accepts fabricated definition scope while stale target ownership remains.

analyzer_oracle_import_independence.finding: oracle.mjs imports only node:crypto and does not import analyzer, generator, discovery, or table code.

analyzer_oracle_semantic_independence.finding: The oracle checks output self-consistency, not source semantics. It accepts complete source-candidate omission, a fabricated candidate over ordinary prose, a coordinated false state/disposition, a substituted source URL base with correspondingly changed href, a fabricated scope witness, and a zeroed work counter.

no_throw_and_deterministic_work_bound.finding: The frozen 512-string no-throw sample reproduces, but it is not arbitrary bytes and it omits ordinary valid empty href input whose analysis fails validation. The transition counter measures consumed UTF-16 positions, omits helper comparisons and post-passes, can be changed to zero without oracle rejection, and stays linear while a malformed raw-end family exhibits approximately quadratic elapsed scaling.

trust_and_resource_evidence.finding: Exact local hashes and deterministic fixture output reproduce, but there is no authenticated launcher, transitive dependency/runtime seal, post-import attestation, arbitrary-output regeneration, real staged publisher, real rename/fsync fault injection, arbitrary-byte rail, or full-source RSS/work record. The publication and dependency evidence is a synthetic object accepted by a same-process predicate.

parsimony.finding: The 61092-byte analyzer/oracle/test closure performs repeated source and table scans (including repeated raw-end parseTag scans, per-opening close searches, repeated ancestor searches, and linear candidate deduplication) while still omitting basic Bikeshed headings and semantic oracle checks. The confirmed work and correctness defects defeat the one-stream KISS claim.

zero_credit_truth.finding: The evidence and receipt consistently label the subject RED, formation-only, non-parser, non-production, not full-source, without a normative operation ledger, and zero credit. Those negative scope claims are accurate.

full_credit_eligibility.finding: No denominator, semantic, owner, operation, compatibility, conformance, parser, feature, cost-lattice, movement, integration, megatranche, or production credit is earned.

immediate_168_source_execution.finding: Running or publishing the 168-source denominator from this rejected subject is not lawful under the frozen blueprint or ADDENDA-07 sequencing.

counterexamples.observed: The V9 analyzer emits zero headings because TAG ranges split the physical line.

counterexamples.observed: The V9 analyzer has no Setext recognition and emits zero headings.

blockers.impact: Heading and operation owners are false, missing, or unpinned even before full-source execution.

counterexample.expected: </script!> is not an appropriate script end tag; following bytes remain RAW_SCRIPT through EOF and both shorthand intervals are reviewed-excluded.
counterexample.observed: parseTag accepts </script!> as name script; [=leaked=] becomes VISIBLE_TEXT/INCLUDED, and verifyAnalysis accepts the result.

blockers.impact: Opaque-state boundaries and reference dispositions are not trustworthy.

blockers.axis: candidate validity and UTF-8 state coordinates

counterexamples.expected: A valid empty href is either represented by a contract-valid empty-value disposition or omitted by an explicit empty-value rule; analysis validation must not fail.
counterexamples.observed: The analyzer emits a candidate at [9,9); verifyAnalysis rejects CANDIDATE_INTERVAL.

counterexamples.expected: The ESCAPE transition consumes the next Unicode scalar consistently with the exercised \x behavior, ending after UTF-8 byte 5.
counterexamples.observed: ESCAPE is only [0,1) with raw \, while the four-byte emoji is assigned to VISIBLE_TEXT. The classifier advanced into a surrogate pair in UTF-16 coordinates.

blockers.impact: Ordinary valid markup cannot always satisfy the analyzer's own oracle, and state boundaries are not genuinely driven by the declared UTF-8 cursor.

blockers.design_defect: Explicit algorithms bind by sequence only and heading-ledger rows bind by first matching anchor; neither path authenticates source_id plus source-byte anchor/reviewed locator as required by the blueprint ledger contract.
blockers.impact: Occurrence-to-ledger bijection and definition ownership can be false while the oracle is green.

counterexamples.observed: verifyAnalysis returns GREEN; the named work_counter_suppression mutation in test.mjs instead raises the counter above the limit and does not test suppression.

counterexamples.family: <script> followed by N repetitions of </script with an unterminated quote
counterexamples.observed: Reported transitions double, while median elapsed time grows about 3.4x, 3.4x, and 4.5x on doubling because findRawEnd invokes parseTag from each false raw-end candidate and each parse scans the remaining suffix.

blockers.impact: The 8*N+64 field is not a deterministic bound on analyzer work and the oracle cannot attest it.

blockers.finding: candidateId truncates SHA-256 to 24 hexadecimal characters and add() silently returns when that truncated ID already exists. This is precisely truncation silence rather than collision rejection.
blockers.impact: The blueprint relation stable_ids_are_collision_checked_without_truncation_silence is not implemented.

blockers.axis: total denominator, trust, resources, and sequencing
blockers.finding: The evidence envelope is an in-memory synthetic transcript, the inherited V8 module exercises V8 code, one local time sample is not a source-corpus resource rail, no complete normative operation ledger exists, no launcher authenticates a transitive closure, and no publisher or real fault injector exists.
blockers.impact: The prototype cannot lawfully generate shards, claim resource closure, or start a publishable 168-source run.

reproduction.counterexample_recipe: Run Node with --input-type=module from the repository root, call analyzeSource(source,{sourceUrl,operationLedger}), apply each explicitly described mutation where present, and call verifyAnalysis(source,result,{operationLedger}). The observed ACCEPTED/REJECTED codes in this review were obtained exactly that way.
reproduction.work_probe_recipe: For N in [500,1000,2000,4000], form source = '<script>' + '</script \"'.repeat(N); warm once; time five analyzeSource calls with process.hrtime.bigint(); report the median and result.transition_count.

credit_truth.reason: Honest RED and zero-credit labels do not cure confirmed analyzer, oracle, owner, and work-proof defects.

required_sequence: Repair the confirmed state, heading, href, UTF-8 escape, ownership, stable-ID, and actual-work defects without editing parser or production files.

Replace self-consistency-only oracle checks with source-semantic checks that reject omissions, fabrications, coordinated state/disposition errors, source-base substitution, fabricated ownership, duplicate occurrence binding, and counter suppression.
Route the inherited heading/reference fixtures through the V9 analyzer or freeze equivalent V9 expectations; require exact included and excluded occurrence sets, not lower bounds.
Re-freeze analyzer, oracle, test, fixtures if changed, evidence, and receipt as one new exact subject and rerun both independent challenges.
Materialize and independently review the complete source-anchored normative operation ledger before any 168-source operation claim.

Freeze launcher, transitive module/schema/runtime identities, arbitrary-output equality, real resource/work rails, and real publication fault injection before attempting a publishable 168-source result.
